github.description: Used for Slingshot's Create/Update Pull Request feature so AI-generated review comments can be posted directly from the agent into PR descriptions on the project's GitLab mirror workflow.

jira-confluence.description: Optional — used during requirements gathering to pull the KYC/onboarding user stories referenced when scaffolding the submission form fields, so generated code matches the acceptance criteria without re-typing them into every prompt.

notes: MCP servers are configured per-workspace via '/ -> Install Agent Skills' style flows in Slingshot settings; no secrets are committed to this file. Actual credentials are supplied via the Slingshot desktop app's secure credential store, not this repo.
